description:
Hi! I am a 6th grader from Vietnam who loves coding and game design. My team is building a game/software application to help farmers use NASA data for the 'Field Shift' challenge.

You should join my team if you love using technology to solve real-world problems. I am looking for teammates who have skills in:

Coding / Game Development.

Researching NASA Earth observation data.

Pitching and presentation. Let's build an awesome app together!
